answer: Each epoch, every key gets its own VRF-seeded toy repo with one planted bug, plus hidden tests kept in a sealed vault until the deadline. The key must ship a patch that passes them. A real fix costs about 20 minutes of model time, so 100 aliases mean 100 separate repairs, not one. Patches are diffed pairwise: a fix that is an echo of another key's (AST match over 0.9 after renaming) merges both into one seat. Each patch also needs a cause note no longer than a sonnet, spot-graded by 3 jurors to catch pasted fixes.
